def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # enclosed non-frame cells are interior; identify connected components of background cells not touching edge,
    # then if bounded by a single-color frame, recolor by area.
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        # components of cells not belonging to any outline color. Background is most frequent color.
        bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
        if grid[r][c]!=bg: continue
        q=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; edge=False
        for y,x in q:
          comp.append((y,x)); edge |= y in (0,h-1) or x in (0,w-1)
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==bg:
              seen.add((yy,xx));q.append((yy,xx))
        if not edge and comp:
          # fill enclosed blank cells; small singleton marker differs from larger cavity
          color=7 if len(comp)==1 else 2
          for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=color
    return out
PY
